evals.name: spring-boot-to-quarkus
evals.prompt: Migrate this Spring Boot application to Quarkus. The app is a simple REST API with database access using Spring Data JPA. I need it running on OpenShift with all the containerization and deployment configs ready.
evals.expected_output: Complete migration from Spring Boot to Quarkus including: analysis report, migration plan with tasks, executed migration with code changes, containerization, deployment manifests for OpenShift, and final comprehensive migration report.

evals.name: nodejs-express-modernization
evals.prompt: I need to modernize this old Node.js Express app and deploy it to OpenShift. Not sure what the best approach is, but we want to use current best practices and get it containerized.
evals.expected_output: Complete modernization workflow including codebase analysis, requirements gathering with user interaction, migration plan for Node.js modernization, execution of updates, containerization, OpenShift deployment configs, and final migration report.

evals.name: java-ee-to-spring-boot
evals.prompt: Migrate this Java EE application to Spring Boot. It's a legacy monolith with EJBs and needs to run on OpenShift eventually.
evals.expected_output: Full migration orchestration from Java EE to Spring Boot including: rgctl/mig-rgctl analysis of EJB structure, requirements gathering, comprehensive migration plan handling EJB to Spring conversion, execution of migration tasks, containerization, OpenShift deployment, and final report.
